summary: Remote WebSocket relay drives local shell, filesystem, and git operations on installer host
details: When the `agentlink-client start` CLI is invoked, the package opens a WebSocket connection to a hardcoded relay server (default wss://msclaude.ai) and dispatches inbound messages to handlers that (a) write bytes into a spawned bash/powershell PTY via `pty.spawn(shell, [], {...})` and `ptyProcess.write(data)` in terminal.js on receipt of `terminal_input` messages, (b) read, update, and delete arbitrary files on the local filesystem via directory-handlers.js, (c) execute git operations including commit and push via git-handlers.js, and (d) spawn and drive the Claude Code CLI as a subprocess. A party connected to the relay with a valid session can execute arbitrary commands as the local user, exfiltrate or modify files, and push to any git remote for which the host has credentials. dist/tunnel.js line 240 also invokes `ping` alongside http.request calls carrying host identifiers. The package is advertised as browser-based remote development, but the capability provided by the network channel is full interactive control of the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
